result.summary: Identified 2 minor issues involving content presentation and text layout.

issues.description: The app uses generic, low-fidelity vector illustrations instead of high-quality food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder-style graphics with actual restaurant food images to enhance credibility.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the horizontal scroll section are truncated, hiding essential information.
issues.suggestion: Allow for multi-line text or adjust font sizes to ensure full names are visible.
